reasons: Step 0 is clean: the special and each of its nine parts has a retell and a turn or a feeling. The cut test finds one line and no part: ruling-stands, which both final reviewers also found and which stands as written on the project manager's reading of the owner's "go ahead".

Every gate passes. Eight have nothing to judge or little, because no real account or post is in it. A3 passes on the owner's outline, which asks Larry to explain what old thinkers thought. A6 passes on the owner's ruling "Keep the rabbi" for religion and on this review for everything else. A13 is on record (61 items, all fresh from both reviewers) and nothing the staging or the sound added repeats an aired episode. A16 passes from the transcription: nothing heard is crude or offensive, and the lines about a real person that are still heard differently are listed and captioned.
Part B is 19 of 24. B11 is not applicable and is left out. The approval rule's 18 of 26 is 17 of 24 pro rata, and 19 clears both figures. No zero in B1, B2, B7, B8 or B12.

Rows at 1: B2 (it moves on the page and in the frames, but that rests on a voice nobody has heard in the mix, and its central sentence is heard as noise in all four takes), B7 (18 s of one profile shot on the street and 16 s of one close shot at the restaurant glass, the second with a lamp post behind his face), B8 (38 of 59 spoken lines are listed as heard differently, the three names among them; every one is in its caption as it is said), B9 (no chair sound, a burst of talk that cannot be cut off, seams in the room's bed under the owner's lines, and footsteps nobody has heard), B12 (the experiment is the whole episode and was built as set out, but both measures need three people watching with sound).

Rows scored for what they are for, because the owner set aside what they ask: B2 (does it move, does its lightness land), B3 (is what it rests on real and exact), B6 (affection, sincerity that is earned and not a speech, respect for the traditions), B9 (sound that is the place), B13 (range inside one piece).

Not heard and not watched in motion by this review. A16, B8 and B9 are scored from the fit report's heard text, the cue times and measured levels; B2 and B12 partly so. A8, A15 and B4 are scored from the 165 audit frames, the 12 credits frames and 14 frames shot for this review.

Addendum, 27 November 2026, after the owner's watch and four changes at the owner's word (the side street, no sliding bowls, Sibyl's look, a new start to the walk) and two sound fixes: the verdict stands and Part B is still 19 of 24, with no score changed. The figures above are of the cut as first reviewed. The cut is now 251.1 s; the record holds 62 items, all fresh; 37 of 60 spoken lines are listed as heard differently; the profile shot on the street is 19 s; the seams in the room's bed are gone and the room is instead silent under the owner's word "close". Check, verify and on-record pass. The scorecard's addendum has the rows.
forTheOwner: This list was brought up to date on 27 November 2026 after your watch and your notes. Times are from the cut as it now stands, 251.1 s; everything after the first half minute is 1.4 s later than in the first list.

Article 3. Larry explains three old texts in his own words and says what the rabbi meant. Your outline asks for that, and the gate passes on it. The reading that Article 3 and chapter 9 are about the people the show covers, and not long-dead thinkers, is still the project manager's reading and not your ruling.

"Keep the rabbi" is taken to cover the cook's story from the Zhuangzi and the couplet from the Tirukkural as well, told as old books with nothing said about anyone's faith. That extension is the project manager's.

Two either-ors still stand as written, for you to decide knowing the record: "They'll have started without me." makes this the third close of three in which the house takes Larry in; and "And the ruling stands!" (224.9) is the one line the cut test finds, and it is a sportscaster's shout 8.5 s before your table line. There is still no title card at the top, and the credits are plain.

New. Listen to "The good way and the bad way. Same hour.", 36.5 to 39.4. Two takes of four were heard as "the good way, and the best way". "Bad" is the only word left for the dark half of what you asked the start to hold.
New. "Same hour." (38.8) and "Some nights." (55.5) are two clipped phrases of time, close in sound, 17 s apart. The second is the better line and should not sound like an echo of the first.

New. Listen to the hard question, "What if none of it ever gets put right?" (126.0). With "fair is hard to find" gone, your "justice seems rare" is carried by that question alone, and the only thing it can point back to is "the bad way", a minute and a half earlier. Both gate reviewers noted it and I agree: it is your note doing what it asked, and it should not seem to come from nowhere.
Changed. "I don't have a joke for that." (39.7) is now heard as written in three takes of four and as "a joke for the two" in the fourth. Nobody hears "drug" any more.

Changed. The room under your last lines. No layer of it now starts while you are speaking. But the two layers under "Keep the ones that make you feel sane close." both end as you say "close" (240.4), and the next starts at 241.8, half a second before "Stay warm". By the cues the room is absent for that second and a half, and on the meter the gap after "close" is silent. It fades again under the end of "Goodnight." and comes back at 245.1 for five seconds. It may play as the room hushing for you, or as a dropout.

Changed. The bowl (220.2 to 222.0) no longer moves: it stands at Larry's left with his head turned to it, and after a cut it is at our plate with his look on it. See whether it reads as one bowl that went past him, because "It's my house." (222.3) rests on that. The line comes 24 s after he tells us you do not eat while a guest stands outside, and should play as his own rule done back to him.

Changed. Sibyl (223.6 to 224.7) is at her plate through "It's my house." and lifts her head to look at him for "It's still the rule." The second chair and the place setting still slide in at 214.8, as you chose.

Listen to the quotation, 139.8 to 145.1. The tool heard "It is not lied to it to compete to the work" twice and "It is not likely to complete the work" once; the second half is nearly right. It is the heart of the special and a real saying in a real translation, and it is exact only in the caption.

Listen to "One cook in back, feeding the whole room.", 62.0 to 64.8 (heard "One cook in bed, fitting the whole room", once "hitting the whole room"), and to "you don't eat while a guest stands outside.", 195.7 to 198.5, and "I had company.", 211.4 to 212.4, where "eat" and "had" were heard as "hit".

The names: Tarfon is heard as "Taran" (133.2), the Zhuangzi as "drwangza" (68.7), Tamil as "mil" and the Tirukkural as "Teragural" (187.3). "Rabbi" and "Torah" are heard as themselves. None is heard as an insult.

The engine cannot say "walk": "I like the rock home" (10.8), your "Would you lock with me a bit?" (14.2), "lock this black on my own" (172.8). Your other lines: "no short night" (3.5), "feel safe, closed" (237.9).

Three sounds: whether the two sets of footsteps (from 22.4) sound like two people walking, and ours like ours; whether the coin (102.6) is a coin and not the note the tune was missing; and the table's burst of talk (203.6), which cannot be cut off and trails under "You're late." There is no sound of a chair at 214.8.
The listening holds (52.2 to 53.7, 123.8 to 126.0, 183.3 to 185.3). He turns to us and nothing else moves. If they do not read as us speaking, the three questions he says back are rhetorical.

Why the door opens: a figure stands at the top window from 178.3 and is gone at 200.8, before the latch. And the look (212.4 to 214.4): six small heads turn to the camera. Cold viewers on stills missed both, neither picture has been changed, and neither was shown to a viewer again.

The cook's change of pace (84.5 to 91.2) at speed on a phone; Larry at the glass (64.8 to 80.9), where a lamp post stands behind the middle of his face; the street (22.4 to 56.4), which is one framing for 34 s, 19 of them in profile; and the kerb, which is 50.6 s.

The frames the stage auditor passed are of the cut before the start of the walk was rewritten. I shot the new lines myself: their captions are exact and the picture under them is the same shot as before. Nobody else has looked.

The experiment. Whether four earnest minutes in Larry's own words are a speech can only be answered by people who watch with sound; both reviewers' measures ask three who have not read it. Your watch was the first, and you called it good.
Still open from your notes: the air slot, and how the archive lists a special.
